articles.title: Partial Retreat: Ten Months of § 101 Data After the Surge
articles.content:
根据美国专利商标局（USPTO）局长约翰·斯奎尔斯（John Squires）2025年9月就任以来，美国专利审查委员会（PTAB）针对§101（专利资格）驳回决定的翻转率显著提升。初步数据显示，这一趋势在2026年4月后出现明显回调。

数据分析显示：
- 2025年10月至2026年3月，PTAB在涉及§101驳回的行政专利申请中，完全翻转驳回决定的比例为21%；
- 2026年4月至7月，这一比例下降至15%；
- 斯奎尔斯任职前（2024年1月至2025年9月）的基准水平为9.4%。

虽然翻转率较之前的峰值有所下降，但仍显著高于历史水平。这表明PTAB在专利资格审查标准上进行了某种程度的调整，但尚未完全回归到斯奎尔斯任职前的政策框架。
articles.summary:
by Dennis Crouch

This is the third post tracking Section 101 reversals at the PTAB. The first, PTAB Doubles Section 101 Reversal Rate Under Director Squires (Jan. 2, 2026), reported that the Board's reversal rate on eligibility rejections roughly doubled after John Squires was sworn in as USPTO Director in September 2025. The second, Recalibration: Seven Months of PTAB § 101 Data (Apr. 23, 2026), found the surge had cooled off its November peak and settled into what looked like a new equilibrium near 20%. Data through July 31, 2026 shows that equilibrium has not held.

The numbers. From October 2025 through March 2026, the Board reversed the examiner's § 101 rejection outright in 21% of ex parte appeals that reached an eligibility holding. From April through July 2026 the rate is 15%. The pre-Squires baseline, running January 2024 through September 2025, was 9.4%. What we're seeing here is a partial retreat, not a reversion.
